_comment: Hand-written prompt overrides for LIBERO-90 tasks where Pi0.5 baseline got 0/5 in the V(h) seed=7 5cm eval (data/contact_mpc/v_libero90/...). Keys are 0-indexed task_ids (passed to task_suite.get_task). Strategies: (A) decompose compound steps to the FIRST primitive, (B) emphasize grasping/contact, (C) make spatial reference explicit.
1: close the top drawer of the cabinet
3: open the top drawer of the cabinet
grasp the butter at the back
4: open the top drawer of the cabinet
grasp the butter at the front
5: open the top drawer of the cabinet
6: reach toward the bottom drawer handle
7: reach toward the top drawer handle
15: pick up the middle black bowl
16: pick up the front black bowl
17: pick up the middle black bowl
18: pick up the frying pan handle
